genres: Action; Adventure; Indie; RPG; Early Access
short_description: Afallon is a single-player RPG with the feel of an MMO. Choose your class and race to forge a unique character, explore a large open world with diverse zones and biomes, and experience a living world that changes based on your actions.
steam_languages: English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Italian*languages with full audio support
